items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had – it was Dizzy Gillespie’s band. Dizzy played – of course Dizzy played Salt Peanuts. And it was Sarah and a trio with Carl Drinkert and Walter Booker and myself.

ctx.x: Bass player. Yeah. That was our quartet. Then another time, speaking of the time between me learning how to play and leaving town, there was a piano player that was going to school at Howard. His name was Carl Drinkert.
The one that went with Lady Day.
